refuter.evidence: GR2 obliges only an implementor who provides special alignment; docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-195.md states no alignment with or without the clause and no implicit FILLER (GR10 optional automatic alignment not specified). Probe s1run-002 at --std 85: R1 with a DISPLAY item then PACKED-DECIMAL then BINARY then an OCCURS table lays out at LENGTH 16 = sum of the item sizes, and a REDEFINES view R2Y reads [XYZ] from the contiguous image, so statements over the group see no hidden filler. cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.3.7 GR2 'Each implementor who provides for special types of alignment will specify the precise interpretations'. The verdict rests on the plain reading that an implementor providing no special alignment has nothing to describe; DOC-A.1-195 cites §2023 clauses only, but its content discharges the 1985 obligation, so this is a documentation-citation nit, not a conformance failure.
